notes:
- Sidebar: new "Recent" section (last 5 files) and your own folder groups (e.g. a client or references) – add folders with +, by dragging, or from a folder's right-click menu › Add to group
- Customize the sidebar: hide and show items and sections, drag sections to reorder, collapse them, rename and recolor groups; "Restore defaults" in the sidebar and in Settings › Window
- Grid / list is now remembered per folder (e.g. Downloads always as a list); the default view and the list of folders are in Settings › Window
